title: Floor
description: A level of the home, e.g. the ground floor.

level.description: Ordering from lowest to highest; 0 is the entrance level, negative is below ground.

FloorId.description: Format of a slug (floor id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.

Name.description: A human-readable name. 1-100 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.
